tools.description: Look up who is behind a phone number in the Netherlands, Belgium or Luxembourg: community reports, spam and scam categories, a trust verdict, and the registered business if there is one, from the Calmido phone directory. Use it whenever someone asks who called them, whether a number is safe, spam or

description: Find a phone number in the Calmido directory (Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg). The query is a phone number, international (+31 20 123 4567) or national (020 123 4567); it is not a name or free text. Returns the matching directory entry, if any. Pass its id to `fetch` for the verdict and reports.

description.name: fetch
description.description: Retrieve who is behind a phone number from the Calmido directory: the community verdict, the number of reports, the most reported category and the registered business, with a link to the evidence. The id is the one `search` returned: the number in E.164 digits.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_phone_number" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
